info.title: ValorBrain Engine API
info.description: REST interface for ValorBrain's memory engine — search, retrieval, document lifecycle, RAG chat, knowledge graph, and multi-tenant management.

tags.name: Memory
tags.description: Memory briefing and typed memories (REST mirrors of the MCP memory tools)

tags.name: Search
tags.description: Hybrid search, temporal, hierarchical, and retrieve

get.description: Returns 200 if the process is up. No auth, no store dependency.

Public callers (through the tunnel, no credential) get only status, version and uptime_seconds. Local operators and authenticated callers also get git_hash, database, db_health, tenant corpus counts and request context. The tenant corpus counts are cached per tenant and can be about 68 s old; corpusAsOf says when they were read, and GET /stats reads them every time.

corpusAsOf.description: When the tenant corpus counts were read (tenant-scoped calls only).

post.description: Create or update a document in a collection. Supports quality gate evaluation, schema packs, auto-linking, and temporal metadata. The tenant comes from the credential (X-Tenant-ID only with the platform token). New content on a path whose document was forgotten (forget, memory_forget) is a new document — 201, action "created", `revived: true`, new id, the writer's, nothing inherited; the forgotten row stays forgotten under `<path>#forgotten-<id>-<random>` (FB-0217). Two writes bringing the same forgotten path back at once: one creates, the other gets a 409 and writes nothing. `#forgotten-` is reserved for those rows: a path carrying it is a 400. The same content after the forget answers "unchanged" with `active: false` and `archived_reason`. A document archived for another reason stays archived. created, updated and unchanged answers carry `active`, plus `archived_reason` when the document is out of reach.

path.description: Unique document path within the collection

metadata.description: Free-form; stored in source_metadata. The keys the server owns are dropped (FB-0233): revisions, ingest_via, ingest_at, author_unverified, claimed_user_id, claimed_user_id_reason, author_kind, author_credential, inferred_event_at.

200.description: Document updated, or nothing written: "unchanged" (same content at the same path), "skipped" (update_strategy no-update) or "deduplicated" (same content in another collection, in a copy the writer may read, its own or with no owner, at least as visible as the write and under the same source ACL domain)

403.description: `not_document_owner` (another member's private document, or a sensitivity change of an owned one) or `sensitivity_change_requires_admin`

404.description: The path holds a document the writer may not read; nothing is written

409.description: `code: "concurrent_write"` — another write brought the same forgotten path back while this one was in flight; nothing was written. Send it again: it is judged against the document now at the path (FB-0217).

get.description: Fetch multiple documents at once by path glob. The `pattern` query parameter is mandatory; `max_bytes` bounds the total body payload and `collection` narrows the glob to one collection. The same blocked-collection predicate applied to search applies here.

parameters.name: max_bytes
parameters.description: Bound on total body payload returned

get.description: Copies of one content under several paths share a docid; the newest copy the caller may read is served, and `collection` + `path` pick one. A document the caller may not read answers exactly like a missing one. The answer carries `id`, the row id (`id:<n>` names that copy).

patch.description: The identifier is resolved like GET /documents/{id} (FB-0219): copies of one content are the newest copy, `id:<n>` names a row, and `collection` + `path` pick one copy. A tenant admin resolves among every document of the tenant, anyone else among those it may read. It took any row of the 6-character prefix. A client that changes one copy (the SaaS) should send `id:<n>`.

docid.description: Short docid of the document changed

403.description: Not the document's owner, and not a tenant admin

404.description: Not found, or a document the caller may not read

post.summary: Pin a document for permanent prioritization

docid.description: Short docid of the document acted on

404.description: Not found, or a document the caller may not read (FB-0232)

post.summary: Temporarily hide a document from context

docid.description: Short docid of the document acted on

404.description: Not found, or a document the caller may not read (FB-0232)

post.description: Deactivates exactly one document: the newest copy the caller may read of the content the docid names, or the copy `collection` + `path` pick, or the row `id:<n>` names. Bare digits that are one row's id and another document's hash prefix are a 409 listing both; nothing is deactivated. The caller must be able to read the document; an owned private document needs its owner, a tenant admin or the platform credential. What was derived from it goes in the same transaction (FB-0222, ADR-088); `cascade` counts it. dry_run=true counts the same cascade, run and rolled back, and changes nothing.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Count what the forget would take (cascade, rolled back) without forgetting

docid.description: Short docid of the forgotten document, whatever identifier named it

cascade.description: What went with it, by table (FB-0222)

404.description: Not found, or a document the caller may not read (same body)

post.summary: Submit relevance feedback for a document
post.description: The identifier is resolved like GET /documents/{id} (FB-0219), among the documents the voter may read: copies of one content are the newest copy, `id:<n>` names a row, `collection` + `path` pick one copy.

user_id.description: Voter, honored only for the platform credential and the tenant's SaaS service key (they act for the session they name). Any other credential votes as its own user; one with no user votes once, as itself.

docid.description: Short docid of the document voted on

404.description: No active document the voter may read

post.description: Full hybrid search: BM25 and dense vectors fused by RRF, then a cross-encoder rerank and MMR diversity. An LLM only expands the query (optional HyDE); it never ranks. Optional self-correct retrieval. Personalized PageRank exists behind a flag and is off in production. Searches DOCUMENTS (prose): keyed facts (upsert_keyed_fact / keyed_facts) are NOT part of the text index — query them via keyed_facts_as_of, or receive the current values with declared precedence via memory_prepare / working_context.

collection.description: Filter to collection (comma-separated list is split)

order.description: Delivery order of the final set

reference_date.description: Anchor for temporal intent detection (default now)

post.description: Auto-classifies query intent and routes to optimal search backend.

collection.description: Comma-separated list is split into multiple collections

post.description: Public endpoint — no auth required. Creates a shadow tenant and returns an API key.

post.summary: Reissue the signup MCP token with the agent key
post.description: Authenticated by the workspace's own `vb_agent_` key only (any other credential gets 401 `agent_key_required`). Mints a new `vbm_` with the signup ceiling — scopes `read write`, toolset `agent`, the key's own expiry — and revokes the previous signup MCP token in the same transaction. Rate-limited per tenant (3 per minute by default).

201.description: New MCP token (raw value shown once)

401.description: Not the workspace's `vb_agent_` key (`agent_key_required`), or an invalid key

429.description: Too many reissues for this workspace

post.summary: Identify an agent by API key
post.description: Requires a Bearer API key (401 when absent).

post.summary: Request ownership claim for an agent
post.description: Requires a Bearer API key (401 when absent).

Requires a Bearer API key (401 when absent). The SaaS calls it instead with the internal secret and the `claim_token` from the signup's `claim_url`. On success the workspace is named for its human and keeps its plan (it changes only when the operator sets `VALORBRAIN_AGENT_PLAN_AFTER_CLAIM`); `login_url` is where the human creates the app login (or adds the workspace to the account that e-mail already has).

login_url.description: Null on an engine without a SaaS configured.

scope.description: Space-separated subset of "read write"; default "read write"

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: RFC 8707 resource indicator; must be served by this AS

credential_kind.description: personal = bound to a person (user_id, else the creator) and acts as that person. gateway = no person, admin only; reads the company view (private documents included), narrowed to the X-User-ID a request names — always send X-User-ID for a person's request. integration credentials are created at POST /api/v1/authority/integrations.

acts_for_users.description: Gateway only (so admin only) — writes act as the tenant member it names, over that user's own documents only.

200.description: Token created (full key returned only once)

key.description: Full API key (shown only at creation)

post.summary: Session briefing plus memory relevant to a message
post.description: REST mirror of the MCP `memory_prepare` tool: identity, task state, what changed, notifications and the memory relevant to `message`, in one call. The tenant comes from the credential.

conflicts.description: The open conflicts about the message's subject the caller may read (FB-0221 phase 3), also told in `blocks.conflicts` and in the `__conflicts__` document delivered first; omitted when there are none, in `fast_mode`, and with `VALORBRAIN_CONFLICT_ANNOTATE=false`.

post.summary: Persist a typed memory (decision, observation, lesson…)
post.description: REST mirror of the MCP `memory_store` tool.

type.description: decision, observation, problem, milestone, handoff, lesson or note.

collection.description: Defaults to the caller agent's collection.

docid.description: Short docid (6-char hash prefix), the identifier GET /documents/{id}, /search and forget use. With "deduplicated", the existing document's. Before FB-0219 this field carried the numeric row id.

id.description: Row id of the document (what `docid` carried before FB-0219)

post.summary: Ingest a whole conversation (turn windows and dated sketch)
post.description: Indexes a conversation the way the transcript watcher does: turn windows plus derived documents. `POST /documents` stays the path for loose text.

400.description: Missing collection, slug or messages, or a slug carrying `#forgotten-`, reserved for forgotten documents (FB-0217)

get.description: Every credential the platform accepts — prefix, issuer, surfaces that accept and refuse it, identity, lifecycle and rate limits. Generated from src/credential-matrix.ts; `sha256` changes whenever the matrix does.

post.description: Pull category-ranked memory in a fixed token budget (mem0-style).

post.summary: Declare which memories an answer actually used (quality loop)
post.description: REST mirror of the MCP `memory_used` tool. The agent declares the docids ('#ab12cd' hex prefixes) or paths of the memories it relied on; optionally a verdict ("confirmed"/"corrected") when the user reacted to what the memory said. Feeds usage coverage, ranking signals and the trust loop. Infra agents excluded downstream.

docids.description: Docids ('#ab12cd') or document paths; [] declares an empty working set (no usage event)

verdict.description: User confirmed or corrected what the memory said (V5)

marked.description: Recall deliveries this declaration credited: per document, the latest delivery by explicit retrieval to the caller's session (X-Session-ID, or the vbm_ token's session key) in the 12 hours before the declaration. 0 without a session.

get.description: Open (and in-progress) update proposals, open conflicts, high-priority proposals and canonical sources with drift. `expired_proposals_count` counts proposals that expired in the last 30 days: an open proposal nobody picks or resolves for 30 days becomes `expired`.

bearerAuth.description: MCP token `vbm_<65 base62 chars> (69 chars)`: Token scopes (`read`, `write`, `admin`, granular ones from src/mcp-scopes.ts; `[]` grants nothing), additive toolsets (`agent,graph`), allowed collections and audience (RFC 8707). An OAuth token asked for MCP or for the app is valid at both (sibling audience, ADR-085); ingest requires `write`. Agent account key `vb_agent_<random>`: Implicit scopes `read write mcp read_log:read secrets` at the REST guard (no billing, pricing, admin or connector credentials); capped at `read write` on the OAuth consent. Service key `vb_<tenant-slug>_<random>`: Implicit scopes `read write mcp read_log:read secrets` at the REST guard (no billing, pricing, admin or connector credentials); capped at `read write` on the OAuth consent. The tenant comes from the credential. Matrix: https://valorbrain-api.valor.digital/.well-known/valorbrain-credentials.json

TenantIdHeader.name: X-Tenant-ID
TenantIdHeader.description: Tenant UUID, meaningful only for the platform credential, which spans tenants. A tenant credential carries its own tenant; a header that disagrees with it is refused (403).

MoneyTenantIdHeader.name: X-Tenant-ID
MoneyTenantIdHeader.description: Explicit target tenant UUID for a money operation. The tenant is never accepted from the JSON body.

DocumentIdentifier.name: id
DocumentIdentifier.description: The short docid every answer carries (a prefix of the content hash, 6 characters, 4 to 64 accepted; `#` in front, URL-encoded as `%23`, says it is a hash prefix and nothing else), or a row id written `id:<n>` (the `id` answers carry). Bare digits without a leading zero are read both ways — a docid can be all digits and older clients send the row id — and when the two readings name different documents the answer is 409 `ambiguous_docid`; resend it as `id:<n>` or `#<hash>`. A number is never taken as a hash prefix alone (FB-0219). Copies of one content under several paths share a docid: the call acts on the newest copy the caller may read, and `collection` + `path` pick one. Clients that keep an identifier should keep `id:<n>` (or collection + path).

DocumentCollection.name: collection
DocumentCollection.description: Narrows the identifier to the copy in this collection (FB-0219).

DocumentPath.name: path
DocumentPath.description: Narrows the identifier to the copy at this path, with `collection` (FB-0219).

AmbiguousDocid.description: `ambiguous_docid`: bare digits that are the row id of one document and a hash prefix of another, both readable by the caller. Copies of the same content are never ambiguous (the newest readable copy is the answer). Each candidate comes with the identifier that picks it alone (`ref`, `id:<n>`); documents the caller may not read are never listed.

ref.description: `id:<n>`, the identifier that names this one alone

hash.description: First 12 characters of the content hash

BillingConflict.description: Source idempotency, settlement proof, provider identity, or subscription period/state conflict. Cross-tenant ownership is never disclosed.

BillingUnprocessable.description: Recognized billing event that cannot be applied

Commitment.description: A promise made to someone outside the company (ADR-087)

first_due_on.description: Due date when first recorded; never moves

days_left.description: Days from today to due_on; negative when overdue

same_counterpart.description: On create, other open commitments to the same counterpart (possible duplicates)

Document.description: What GET /documents/{id} answers (FB-0219 aligned this schema with the handler).

docid.description: Short docid (6-char prefix of the content hash)

id.description: Row id; `id:<n>` names this copy of a docid copies of the same content share

superseded_by.description: Row id of the document that superseded this one (PRD M1), when there is one

IngestResult.description: What POST /documents answers (FB-0219 aligned this schema with the handler).

docid.description: Short docid (6-char prefix of the content hash), the identifier GET /documents/{id}, /search and forget use. Absent on "skipped" and "deduplicated" (see existing_docid).

path.description: Can carry a timestamp suffix with update_strategy appendable

action.description: "unchanged" (VAL-172): posted content hash equals the stored hash for the same path — the engine performs no write and records no audit row.

active.description: Whether the document at the path is live after the call (created, updated and unchanged answers)

revived.description: True when the write created a new document on a path whose document had been forgotten (FB-0217)

archived_reason.description: Why the document at the path is out of reach, when `active` is false (forget, lifecycle, …)

skip_reason.description: Why the quality gate skipped embedding

existing_docid.description: With "deduplicated": short docid of the copy in another collection the writer may read, the writer's own or with no owner, at least as visible as the write and under the same source ACL domain (or both collections unmapped); nothing was written. Any other copy never deduplicates, nor does a write to a path that already holds a document (FB-0229).

existing_id.description: Row id of that copy (what existing_docid carried before FB-0229)

id.description: Row id of this result (REST /search; FB-0219)

mirror_paths.description: Other paths with the same content hash, collapsed into this result (the same file indexed under several paths). Lists only copies the caller can read; omitted when there are none. Returned by /search and /retrieve.

OpenConflict.description: Two values recorded for the same thing, neither replacing the other (`fact_conflicts`, FB-0221), still describing the key.

subject.description: What disagrees, read from the key ("orion launch date")

fact_key.description: The keyed fact the conflict is on, when it is on one

values.description: The other value first, the one the fact row holds second

as_of.description: The day it was stated, when the conflict recorded it

sources.description: `collection/path` of the active documents that stated it

observation_id.description: The consolidated observation that called it unresolved, when one did

BillingEventApplyRequest.description: All four subscription events require provider_subscription_id, period_start, and period_end. Activation and renewal additionally require plan_id and the complete settlement bundle. Their paid period is compared by PostgreSQL without JavaScript timestamp rounding. credit_amount must be zero for every event except credit_grant, where it must be positive. Refund and reversal are recognized but return unsupported_billing_event (422).

source.description: Provider-qualified source. Subscription events use stripe:*, solana:mpp:*, or manual_contract:*.

period_start.description: RFC3339 with an explicit timezone. Original text is preserved in canonical hashing and final event results.

period_end.description: RFC3339 with an explicit timezone and later than period_start.

settlement_network.description: Normalized to lowercase before hashing and proof uniqueness checks.

settlement_reference.description: Globally unique together with lowercase settlement_network when present, regardless of source or tenant.

provider_metadata.description: Small public provider references only. Secret, private, credential, token, mandate, authorization, and signature keys are rejected.

metadata.description: Non-sensitive metadata copied to the credit ledger when applicable. The same secret/private/token/mandate/signature key filter applies.

BillingEventApplyResult.description: Subscription is null for pure credit_grant events. Ignored events keep applied false and include a stable ignored_reason. An identical source replay sets replay true and applied false while preserving the stored subscription, credit, ignored_reason, and event id.

credit_amount.description: PostgreSQL numeric serialized without precision loss.

SubscriptionCreditGrantRequest.description: Legacy Stripe invoice credit. It is journaled as credit_grant and never creates, reads, or mutates tenant_subscriptions.

balance_after.description: Zero on an identical legacy invoice replay.

granted.description: Zero on an identical legacy invoice replay.

error.description: Includes idempotency_conflict, settlement_proof_conflict, subscription_provider_conflict, subscription_period_conflict, invalid_subscription_transition, and unsupported_billing_event.

message.description: Present for validation errors; omitted for conflicts and higher statuses.
